value.name: presses to confirm codicil
value.description: The speaker insists that confirming the existence of a later instrument or codicil is necessary and asks Daniel to help.
evidence: "Then helping me confirm that costs you nothing but a few days."

value.name: Daniel resists delay
value.description: Daniel argues that there is no time to wait because the buyer's agent has made the deadline clear.
evidence: "We don't have a few days. The buyer's agent has been very clear. They have other properties. They —"

value.name: rejects Daniel's urgency
value.description: The speaker dismisses Daniel's concern, saying another buyer will come because the row house is valuable and the office will proceed anyway.
evidence: "Then they will buy one of those properties, and another buyer will come, because this is a row house in Spring Garden and you know what it's worth."
"I am not asking your permission, Mr. Serrano. I am telling you what my office is going to do."

value.name: orders house search and attorney call
value.description: Lucia announces that her office will search the house, call the attorney Rosa remembers, and verify whether a codicil exists.
evidence: "We are going to search the house for the document Rosa describes."
"We are going to call the attorney she remembers being on the phone."
"We are going to confirm or eliminate the existence of a codicil."

value.name: Daniel yields to search
value.description: Daniel briefly reveals panic, then regains composure and agrees to proceed cleanly.
evidence: "Fine. Of course. I want the same thing. I want this clean."

value.name: requests to attend search
value.description: Daniel asks to be present for any search of the house.
evidence: "I would like to be present for any search."

value.name: allows witnesses to attend
value.description: Lucia says Daniel, his sister, and Rosa may all be present, and identifies Rosa as a witness.
evidence: "You will be welcome. So will your sister. So will Rosa."
"Rosa was a witness. Rosa will be present."

value.name: Lucia's remark unsettles Daniel
value.description: Lucia's response provokes an uneasy reaction from Daniel and a suppressed laugh from Lucia.
evidence: Lucia made a sound that was not quite a laugh.
Daniel closed his mouth on whatever he had been about to say.

value.name: sets search appointment
value.description: Daniel asks when the search will happen, and Lucia schedules it for the next morning at ten with a paralegal and Rosa present.
evidence: "Tomorrow morning. Ten o'clock. I'll bring a paralegal. Rosa, can you be here?"
